intro: The Report on the Defias Brotherhood is an official document compiled by City Architect Baros Alexston, detailing the activities and threat posed by the elusive conspirators. Intended to inform the royal court, it is entrusted to an adventurer who has begun unraveling their mysterious plot for personal delivery to Stormwind Keep.

p: Following the long investigation into the unrest plaguing Westfall and the surrounding territories, City Architect Baros Alexston prepared this formal report to alert the leadership of Stormwind to the full scope of the Defias threat. Rather than sending a standard royal messenger, Alexston entrusted the document to the very hero who untangled the conspiracy. Delivered directly to Stormwind Keep, the report is meant to accompany a personal audience detailing Edwin VanCleef's schemes and the danger they pose to the kingdom.
